title: IFC element quantity
description: An IfcElementQuantity: the measured quantities of a thing, kept apart from its property set because a quantity is always a number with a kind, and asking for every volume in a model is a question worth being able to ask directly.

expressId.description: The line number the quantity set had in the file.

name.description: The set's name, such as Qto_WallBaseQuantities. This is also the name of the reference that points at this row.

methodOfMeasurement.description: How the quantities were arrived at, when the file says.

quantities.description: Quantity name to its number, such as { "NetVolume": 2.34 }.

kinds.description: Quantity name to what it measures: Length, Area, Volume, Count, Weight or Time.
